Subject: Draft annotated flow + preliminary subprocessor notes

Ben / Jordan —

Attached is a first-pass annotated dataflow for Mercury that maps the PII fields called out in Mercury_SSQ_v2 and the places where we apply transformations. Key notes below:

- Ingestion: PII (patient name, contact, device ID) enters via secure HTTPS endpoints; we token-ize identifiers at the API gateway layer.
- Transit: All network traffic is TLS 1.3; internal service-to-service traffic uses mTLS.
- Storage: Persistent model and KV cache live on customer-dedicated volumes in AWS us-east-1. Tokenized identifiers are stored in a separate encrypted table.
- KMS: Primary key material is in AWS KMS (us-east-1). We currently offer customer-managed keys via AWS KMS if the account requests a dedicated CMK.
- Subprocessors (prelim):
  * AWS (infrastructure) — us-east-1 (data hosting, KMS)
  * LogTail Inc. (logging/observability) — us-west-2; stores aggregated, redacted telemetry only
  * OptiMetrics (model telemetry/ops) — eu-central-1 for some customers (can be limited per contract)

I've attached Mercury_annotated_dataflow_v1.pdf — it includes colored overlays for PII classification and a short legend for pseudo-/redaction steps.

Open items I flagged on the diagram:
- Need to confirm whether Mercury requires all logs to remain in EU-only region for the opt-ins listed in the SSQ.
- Provide vendor contracts / DPA pages for LogTail and OptiMetrics (Jordan, can you pull the current DPA snippets?).

Prashant — please see the attached and tell us which elements need more granularity (e.g., field-level pseudonymization proofs, retention buckets).

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor

Redwood Inference
